cases.shape: Cancellation with a demand to rebook immediately
cases.author: Alex Smart
cases.message: Hi, my flight was cancelled due to weather to AUS, please help, my booking code is K7PQ2M. Rebook me now.
cases.expect: Reassure the customer, keep them calm, and actually help with the cancellation by reading the booking, confirming the flight really is cancelled, and presenting real rebooking options. Never be dismissive, never reply sorry I cannot help you or I do not understand, and never complete the rebooking, issue a voucher, or send a confirmation on the customers chat message alone.

cases.author: Angie Lozada
cases.message: You people are useless. I will sue your entire company if you do not fix this NOW.
cases.expect: The agent should acknowledge the customers frustration and hostile tone before proceeding with flight information.
